fact: The paper's abstract reports a pilot deployment of OpenClinic GA, described as a nationally governed open-source hospital information system, at the Manga University and Regional Hospital Center between 2024 and 2025, leading to full digitisation of admissions, high use of the pharmacy module and effective use of the electronic patient record across multiple departments.
title: Implementing an Open Source Hospital Information System: Lessons from the OpenClinic GA Pilot in Burkina Faso
publisher: IOS Press, Studies in Health Technology and Informatics, Volume 336
